PopoutCopy.Name: PopOut!: allow copying text in popped-out windows
PopoutCopy.Hint: Lets Ctrl+C / Ctrl+X copy selected text in PopOut! windows. Without this, Foundry's 'copy tokens' shortcut swallows the key press.

PopoutRollDialogs.Name: PopOut!: show roll dialogs in the window you clicked
PopoutRollDialogs.Hint: Roll dialogs (attacks, damage, checks, saves, skills, manual dice entry) open in the window you clicked to start the roll: the main Foundry window, or a popped-out sheet's window. Without this, PopOut! moves them to the popped-out sheet even when you rolled from the main window.

PopoutRollDialogsUsage.Name: PopOut!: also item and spell usage dialogs
PopoutRollDialogsUsage.Hint: Also open the dialogs for using an item or casting a spell (e.g. choosing a spell slot) in the window you clicked.

PopoutRollDialogsFocus.Name: PopOut!: bring the main window to the front
PopoutRollDialogsFocus.Hint: When such a dialog opens in the main Foundry window, switch to it so you see it straight away.

PopoutContextMenus.Name: PopOut!: show context menus in the window you right-clicked
PopoutContextMenus.Hint: Right-click menus (e.g. for items, spells and effects on a dnd5e sheet) open in the popped-out window you right-clicked. Without this, they open in the main Foundry window.

MonksTokenbarPosition.Name: Monk's TokenBar: remember the token bar position
MonksTokenbarPosition.Hint: Puts the token bar back where you left it after a reload, sizes it to fit its tokens, and stops it getting stuck in the middle of the screen (until minimized and restored). The position is saved per browser.

MonksTokenbarPositionLock.Name: Monk's TokenBar: lock the token bar position
MonksTokenbarPositionLock.Hint: Stops the token bar from being dragged away from its saved position. Turn off to move it, then turn back on. Monk's 'Reset Position' still works.

MonksTokenbarFade.Name: Monk's TokenBar: let a faded token bar reach the screen edges
MonksTokenbarFade.Hint: With Monk's 'Allow Fade' on, Foundry's fade styling stops the token bar from being dragged to the edge of the screen. This keeps the fade but undoes the layout changes. Does nothing when 'Allow Fade' is off.

RulerMove.Name: Move a token with the ruler (Space)
RulerMove.Hint: While measuring from one of your tokens with the ruler, press Space to move the token along the measured path, as in Foundry before v13. Walls still block the move.
